name: Duos Technologies Group, Inc.

profile.description: Jacksonville, FL company that divested its rail inspection business and now builds Edge AI data centers and colocation through Duos Edge AI.

innovation.label: DEVELOPING
innovation.analysis: Track record 2/3: divested the rail business to pivot to Edge data centers, opening a new revenue stream [1]. AI 2/2: Duos Edge AI shipping edge compute with Technology Solutions revenue of $3.23M in Q2 and gross margin up to 55.8% from 37.3%. Share 0/2 (small player), pipeline 2/2 (five-year, 55 MW Axe Compute colocation worth $111M; $43.5M backlog; >$70M exit ARR target), R&D 0/1.

inspiration.label: WEAK
inspiration.analysis: Mission floor 2/4: clear Edge AI infrastructure purpose under CEO Doug Recker (since April 2026) [2], not distinctive. Community 0/2, retention 0/2, insider buying 0/2: no evidence found.

infrastructure.label: STRONG
infrastructure.analysis: Calculated mechanically (Growth sleeve). D/E 0.5%, ROE 36% (2x), revenue growth 29.5%, forward P/E 17.8 and profit margin 150% all hit targets for 1.0; 5yr CAGR and PEG unavailable and excluded. Weighted 6.0 of 6 gives 10. Note the margin and ROE are inflated by the rail divestiture gain; liquidity floor clear at about $8.3M daily dollar volume.

ai_resilience.label: LOW RISK
ai_resilience.analysis: AI Risk 7/9: Edge colocation is physical, power-constrained infrastructure that benefits from AI workload growth, though GPU-as-a-service economics and tenant concentration (Axe Compute) are risks [1]. AI Opportunity 1/1: Technology Solutions revenue of $3.23M and GPU-as-a-service contributions expected in the >$50M 2026 guide.

infinite_game.summary: Duos shows real existential flexibility but the cause and culture are unproven; the pivot is early.

just_cause.analysis: Just Cause (1/3): bringing compute to underserved edge markets is distinctive but recent, with the company reinventing itself within a year.

trusting_teams.analysis: Trusting Teams (1/2): Glassdoor 2.9/5 with 51% CEO approval and a new CEO suggest average, not high, trust [2].

worthy_rivals.analysis: Worthy Rivals (0/1): no evidence of rival-learning language.

existential_flexibility.analysis: Existential Flexibility (2/2): abandoned its core rail inspection business for data center infrastructure, a fundamental reinvention.

courage_to_lead.analysis: Courage (1/2): exited the established rail business to focus on a capital-intensive new strategy, with the first positive operating quarter only in Q2 2026 [1].

investment_thesis: Bull case: Q2 2026 revenue rose 30% to $6.18M, gross profit up 94% to $3.45M, and the company reconfirmed >$50M 2026 revenue with $112.3M cash and a $43.5M backlog [1]. The $111M Axe Compute colocation and a >$70M Q4 exit run rate at >70% gross margin would transform scale.
thesis_continued: Bear case: Q2 revenue missed estimates, operating income was just $0.05M, and the 150% profit margin reflects a one-time divestiture gain. Reaching >$50M from $6.2M quarterly revenue requires heavy execution, customer concentration with Axe Compute is high, and Glassdoor is 2.9/5 [2].
key_catalysts: Execution on the Axe Compute 55 MW five-year colocation
GPU-as-a-service revenue ramp toward >$70M exit ARR
Deploying the $112.3M cash into Edge AI sites
key_risks: Guidance of >$50M for 2026 requires steep H2 acceleration
New CEO and strategy transition with thin operating profit
sources: Duos Technologies Q2 2026 results, Yahoo Finance / Stock Titan, September 2026
Duos Technologies executive team and Glassdoor, accessed October 2026
